# ORA Dental Wellness

> Quiet-luxury dental clinic in Bahria Town Phase 4, Rawalpindi, Pakistan — dentist-led care in a calm atelier-style environment for Rawalpindi, Bahria Town, and Islamabad patients.

ORA Dental Wellness is located at Bahria Paradise Commercial, Bahria Town Phase 4, Rawalpindi. Appointments preferred; walk-ins welcome subject to availability. Hours: Monday–Saturday, 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM.
